checks.description: Root element uses correct BEM base class
checks.notes: Root element is .avatar with BEM modifier pattern.

checks.description: Size modifiers are exclusive and required
checks.rule: Exactly one size modifier (.avatar--24 through .avatar--120) must be present
checks.notes: Seven size modifiers documented and implemented.

checks.rule: Image avatars must use with alt attribute, not CSS background
checks.notes: HTML template uses with alt. Deviation from Figma RECTANGLE background is intentional and documented in analysis.md.

checks.description: Icon and Initials types require role and aria-label
checks.rule: When avatar conveys identity, root element must have role='img' and aria-label with person's name
checks.notes: Documented in contract and template. Enforcement is implementation-side.

checks.rule: .avatar__icon and its SVG child must have aria-hidden='true'
checks.notes: Template and showcase use aria-hidden='true' on .avatar__icon span.
Documented in contract. Template includes aria-hidden='true'.

checks.description: Image type requires meaningful alt attribute
checks.rule: must have non-empty alt attribute
checks.notes: Documented in contract. Enforcement is implementation-side.
Overflow counter is visual-only. Group aria-label conveys total count semantically.

checks.description: Avatar Group requires group role and label
checks.rule: .avatar-group must have role='group' and aria-label describing the collection
checks.notes: Template and showcase include role='group' and aria-label examples.

checks.rule: CSS must use --avatar-* tokens for background, border, radius, and group gap
checks.notes: Component-level tokens (--avatar-bg-default, --avatar-border-color, etc.) are not yet defined in token.css. CSS currently uses fallback Figma token names with TODO comments. See analysis.md Missing Tokens section.

checks.rule: Avatar CSS must not reference --Button-* tokens
checks.notes: --Button-button-background-neutral-default is used as avatar fill fallback. Tracked in analysis.md High severity finding. Requires --avatar-bg-default to be defined in token.css.

checks.description: No hardcoded hex values in component CSS
checks.rule: All color values must use CSS custom properties with hardcoded fallbacks only
checks.notes: All color values use var(--token, #fallback) pattern.

checks.rule: Component must implement all states declared in Figma manifest
checks.notes: Manifest declares Default state only. No interactive states. Avatar is display-only.

Avatar does not define its own focus ring. Focus belongs to the interactive wrapper if avatar is placed inside a link or button. Documented in analysis.md Focus Layer Decisions and contract.md Constraints.
